name: shfmt
description: Shell script formatter supporting POSIX sh, Bash, and mksh with customizable styles

tools.description: Format and pretty-print shell scripts with consistent style and indentation
tools.usage:
shfmt script.sh # Format and print to stdout
shfmt -w *.sh # Format files in-place
shfmt -i 4 script.sh # Use 4-space indentation
shfmt -d script.sh # Show diff of changes
shfmt -ln bash script.sh # Format as Bash script
